messages.author: 5436e4d7e68c8875
messages.subject: Latent Variable Estimation
parts: For the mirt function if you put a regression equation into the formula part what is it doing differently than estimating latent variable scores and then running a regression separately? To put this question another way I know you can theoretically run a regression with the whole distribution of a latent variable instead of just point estimates, like a MIMIC model, is that what this does? Thanks.

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Latent Variable Estimation
parts:
Yes, it's exactly like what the MIMIC model does. The estimation of the parameters is baked-in to the likelihood equations, which is why likelihood ratio tests are also possible in mirt. 

Phil
